faqHeading: Military Movers FAQ for Boston Service Members

faq.q: Do military movers in Boston handle PCS moves?
faq.a: Yes. We plan PCS moves around your orders and report date, with out-of-state moves quoted at a flat rate.

faq.q: Can you store my household goods until base housing is ready?
faq.a: Yes. We store your things and deliver once housing at the new station is ready. Storage is priced by the cubic feet your items take up.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book a PCS move?
faq.a: As soon as you have orders. Moves in late August and September compete with the Boston lease season, so the earlier you book, the more dates are open.

faq.q: Can you pack the whole house before we leave?
faq.a: Yes. Full packing can be added to the quote, so the crew boxes the home while you handle out-processing.

faq.q: Is Better Life Moving a broker or a carrier?
faq.a: A carrier. We move you with our own crews and trucks under USDOT 3866930, MC 1414489.

faq.q: What paperwork should I have ready for the quote?
faq.a: Your report date, the pickup window you're allowed and both addresses are enough to price the move. Mention any rules your orders set for packing or storage, and the manager plans the move around them.

faqClosing: Still have a question about a PCS move? Our FAQ page covers billing, booking and moving day.
